comments.author: ViP3R_76
comments.body_html:
We used this weapon with distribution to enemy bots (through APBS) and it opens some errors within the raids.

Namely - Audioloop-Bug - afterwards (if audioloop occured in a raid) - Extraction is not possible anymore.

Calling the function for the sound-player seems to be the culprit. (Lacy mentioned it while checking my logs).

We use some other WTT Weapon mods (not much) which are working (or simply lucky?) fine. Maybe worth to take a look on it?

comments.author: Tron
comments.body_html:
Very interesting. Not sure why only that weapon would be the culprit, as all of our weapons are made the exact same way, using ready-made templates. The template that made this weapon was actually used to make previous rifles. In terms of how audio is handled, the audio file is just a wav file that is referenced in an audio bank file. The bank file is then referenced in the container from a script. We reuse existing Tarkov/BSG audio bank files and weapon container prefabs with their default scripts. So I would be surprised if the error is occurring from the bank or container itself, as they are default BSG prefabs.

I can take a look at the wav files, maybe pertaining to mainly distant sounds? Either way, unsure why this would occur with only this weapon, as we haven’t changed our methods for weapon creation since our first release. Please let me know if this occurs with other weapons and not just this one.

comments.author: PettZon
comments.body_html:
Having the same issue that ViP3R_76 mentioned a few comments below!

Me and my friends play using FIKA, and use APBS to distribute modded weapons to AI. Occasionally whenever an AI gets a WoS weapon and fires it, the sound gets stuck playing repeatedly, preventing extraction.

The sounds that get stuck playing always happen very far away from us players, and sometimes whenever we hunt down the source of the sound and when getting close enough, the sound loop stops and extraction becomes possible once more. (This isn’t always the case though).

We also use basically every other WTT gun (Absolutely love your guys work!), but this particular issue seem to be specific to WoS. Every time we’ve hunted down the source, the nearby PMC has WoS equipped.

We love using WoS and appreciate all the work that’s gone into this and keeping it up to date! If there’s any suggestion or possible fix, we’d love to know!

comments.author: Tron
comments.body_html: We have explored this with the users that reported the issues and could not find out why just this weapon causes the issue (versus all of our other weapons). All of our weapons use the same template, and build workflow, so this bug had us scratching our heads. The best method to fix this bug is to just blacklist it from bots for now.
